name: Veranda (incl. Infinite Veranda)
notes: Edge-class Infinite Verandas: 131-184 sq ft plus 42-45 sq ft enclosed balcony area (TPG figures conflict).

name: Concierge Class
notes: Veranda layout + dedicated concierge, welcome lunch, priority dining/excursion support. Priority boarding: sources conflict (left unknown).

name: AquaClass
notes: Blu restaurant (AquaClass-exclusive), unlimited thermal suite (SEA Thermal Suite on Edge; Persian Garden on Solstice/Millennium), spa concierge. Size range varies by class.

name: The Retreat: Sky, Aqua Sky, Celebrity & Signature Suites
notes: Luminae (suite-only restaurant), Retreat Lounge (Michael's Club on Solstice/Eclipse/Reflection), butler, Premium drinks + Premium Wi-Fi. Laundry and unlimited specialty dining start at Royal Suite. Aqua Sky Suites also get thermal suite access. Retreat Sundeck not on Solstice, Eclipse, Reflection, Constellation, Infinity.

name: The Retreat: Royal Suite & above (Royal, Penthouse, Edge Villa, Iconic)
notes: Adds unlimited specialty dining (dinner nightly, lunch on sea days), complimentary laundry + unlimited pressing, unlimited Premium drinks, personalized minibar, thermal suite. Edge Villa and Iconic Suite exist on Edge-class only.

name: Ocean View
notes: Ultra Spacious Ocean View (about 319 sq ft) sleeps up to 6.

name: Balcony
notes: About 182 sq ft plus about 50 sq ft balcony (Symphony).

name: Sea Class: Junior Suites
notes: Priority boarding and a dedicated check-in line. Coastal Kitchen dinner only, by reservation and space permitting; no suite lounge. Coastal Kitchen exists on Oasis, Quantum and Icon class ships.

name: Sky Class: Grand, Owner's & Sky Loft suites
notes: Concierge, suite lounge with evening drinks, all-day Coastal Kitchen, suite sun deck (The Grove on Icon class). VOOM Wi-Fi for one device per person, except Sky Junior and Sunset Junior Suites. Drinks package and laundry not included.

name: Star Class: Royal Loft, Owner's Loft, Grand Loft, Ultimate Family & Villa suites
notes: Royal Genie service, Deluxe Beverage Package, VOOM Wi-Fi, specialty dining at most venues (some items extra), complimentary laundry and pressing, gratuities included (Genie tips extra). Royal Loft sleeps 6; the Ultimate Family Suite (Symphony, Wonder, Spectrum) may sleep more.

name: Cloud 9 Spa staterooms
notes: Unlimited thermal suite and thalassotherapy pool, priority spa booking. Sold as interior, ocean view, balcony and suite. Ship list from a truncated source; other ships may also have them.

name: Family Harbor staterooms
notes: Family Harbor Lounge with continental breakfast, snacks, games; kids 11 and under dine free at some venues.

name: Havana staterooms
notes: Private Havana pool area. All guests in the cabin must be 12 or older. Havana suites pay the suite gratuity ($19).

name: Suites (Junior, Grand, Ocean & Captain's)
notes: Priority check-in, boarding, luggage delivery, tender and debarkation.

name: Excel suites (Excel class only)
notes: Unlimited Loft 19 access (secluded top-deck area with pool and cabanas, priority cabana booking), dedicated concierge line, guaranteed specialty dining times. Reported extras: Bottomless Bubbles soda package and laundry; laundry terms unconfirmed.

name: Reserve Collection mini-suites
notes: Reserve dining area with expedited seating, welcome wine, canapés on request, priority disembarkation. No lounge, no laundry.

name: Reserve Collection suites
notes: Reserve dining, Concierge Lounge, Suite Experience manager, complimentary laundry and professional cleaning (same-day express extra), mini-bar setup, private breakfast venue, priority disembarkation. Priority boarding not stated on the official page.

name: Sanctuary Collection (select suites and staterooms)
notes: Princess Premier is bundled in: premium drinks, unlimited specialty dining, Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, room service. Private spaces and Sanctuary Restaurant. Includes some non-suite staterooms. Sky and Enchanted Princess join in December 2026.

name: Vista & Signature Suites
notes: Official suite amenities list only a no-host mini-bar, binoculars and pillow choice; no concierge, laundry or priority access.

name: Neptune Suites
notes: Neptune Lounge with concierge, complimentary laundry, pressing and dry cleaning, priority check-in, disembarkation and tender boarding. Club Orange private dining only on Pinnacle-class ships; elsewhere priority dining-room seating.

name: Pinnacle Suites (Pinnacle class only)
notes: Neptune perks plus a larger suite with separate living area; Club Orange and Pinnacle Grill breakfast.
